summary: Nasus Pharma Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing the Notice of Meeting, Proxy Statement, and Proxy Card for its Annual and Special General Meeting scheduled for October 8, 2026. The agenda includes routine items: re-appointment of auditors, re-election of two Class I directors, approval of CEO compensation, a one-time bonus for a former CEO, and an increase in shares reserved under an incentive plan. This is an ordinary meeting notice with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is merely procedural and does not trigger a special-situations category.
